node.name: LinkedIn: firm's recent posts
node.description: Up to 50 recent posts from the firm's LinkedIn page (Trigify), where investments and cohorts are often announced first.

inputParameters.name: companyUrl
inputParameters.description: The company professional URL to get posts from, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/grow-with-clay. Returns up to 50 most recent posts.

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: The number of posts to fetch. Minimum is 1, maximum is 50. Defaults to 50.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of posts to fetch. Minimum is 1, maximum is 50. Defaults to 50.
